description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Standing orders the server carries out every tick, even between your tool calls — the safety net for a slow chat. Each call REPLACES all orders; pass nothing to clear them.

- heal_below: cast a heal (healSpell, default "light_healing") below this health percent. Not for knights.
- potion_below: drink a potion (potion, default "health_potion") below this health percent.
- retreat_below: stop fighting and walk to the nearest safe tile below this health percent. Recommended: 35 below level 10.
- auto_reel: reel in fish by itself when one bites (lands them a little less often than reeling yourself).
- auto_target: attack these monster ids by themselves when they are near, e.g. ["rat"].

Orders are checked in that order. Orders never do anything a manual action could not.
